facts.raw_span: 5 days of progressive dyspnea
short of breath only with uphill walking (MMRC grade 1)
breathless on level ground (grade 2)
dyspneic at rest (grade 4)
central, nonradiating chest pain with coughing
denied fever
pulse was 116/min
respiratory rate 30/min
bilateral pitting edema to the knees
decreased movement on the left; trachea deviated rightward; decreased fremitus and stony dullness over the entire left hemithorax; and absent breath sounds on the left
Chest radiograph revealed complete opacification of the left hemithorax with tracheal shift to the right, consistent with massive left pleural effusion
pleural fluid analysis: protein 3.5 g/dL; LDH 1413 U/L; glucose 98 mg/dL; ADA 31.4 U/L; total cell count 100/mm3 (10% neutrophils, 90% lymphocytes); amylase 11,871 U/L
